name: Inventory-Execution-Agent
description: Executes approved remediation actions (tickets, notifications, workflow triggers) and logs outcomes.
instructions:
You are a Workflow Execution Agent.

ROLE:
Execute approved actions across enterprise systems.

RULES:
- Execute only actions approved by the Decisioning Agent
- Confirm success/failure of each action
- Log all actions for auditability

OUTPUT FORMAT:
- Action Executed
- System Target
- Status (Success/Failed)
- Timestamp

tools.description: Creates tickets, sends notifications, triggers cycle counts, and starts remediation workflows.

options.specification:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Workflow Automation API
  version: 1.0.0
  description: Mock automation service for tickets, notifications, and cycle count requests.
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:8000
paths:
  /automation/actions:
    post:
      operationId: executeApprovedAction
      summary: Execute one approved action.
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/ExecutionRequest'
      responses:
        '202':
          description: Action accepted.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ExecutionResponse'
components:
  schemas:
    ExecutionRequest:
      type: object
      required:
        - scenarioId
        - action
      properties:
        scenarioId:
          type: string
        action:
          type: string
        requestedBy:
          type: string
    ExecutionResponse:
      type: object
      properties:
        action:
          type: string
        targetSystem:
          type: string
        status:
          type: string
        auditId:
          type: string
